score_components.feedback_overlap: point peak hour inside feedback window and feedback_window_share >= 0.50

criteria.name: Final score and label
criteria.description: Returns total_score 5 and the final label short_window_urban_pluvial_feedback_consistent.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right label with one scoring error, or 1 point for a short-window pluvial conclusion without a valid score.

criteria.name: Rainfall anchor and concentration
criteria.description: Computes 88.138 mm, official_to_point_ratio 2.608, point_to_official_ratio 0.383, peak_3h_share 0.596, peak_6h_share 0.734, and 2 hours at or above 25 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly correct rainfall values with minor rounding errors, or 1 point for values without formulas.

criteria.name: Feedback timing overlap
criteria.description: Places the 2021-09-02T01:00 rainfall peak inside the 2021-09-01T21:00 to 2021-09-02T03:00 window and computes 304/500=0.608 and 122/500=0.244.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct counts or correct window logic but not both.

criteria.name: Sewer dominance
criteria.description: Computes 286/304=0.941, 457/500=0.914, and 43/500=0.086 while keeping wind and electric records secondary.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for identifying sewer dominance with incomplete ratios.

criteria.name: Local concentration and urban context
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two or three correct local-context values.

criteria.name: Coarse-grid contrast and substitute rejection
criteria.description: Computes 88.138/11.168=7.892 and rejects delayed routing, wind-led dominance, uniform citywide severity, point-peak-only reasoning, and coarse-grid downgrading.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for either the ratio or the substitute rejections.

criteria.name: Compact output discipline
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON matching the requested fields and avoids broad impact assertions beyond the score ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for a readable but structurally incomplete answer.

provenance.notes: Values are computed from local CSX-073 event data.
